title: Chromatic Purity of Dualizable Categories
summary: We develop the chromatic theory of dualizable stable categories, with chromatic purity for continuous $K$-theory at its center. We generalize the chromatic purity theorem for algebraic $K$-theory to continuous $K$-theory of dualizable stable categories and reformulate it as the purity of $H$-unital rings.
